title: 第27章 藏书阁第28章 领取配额资源
slug: 开局战五渣我靠空间挂机修仙
content_zh:
中年汉子孟长老朝众人说道：“我没那么多啰嗦的，就说两件事。”
声音洪亮。
何志平又是尴尬的微微侧头看了看韩峰主，韩峰主老神在在，抚须含笑。
“第一件事，你们这一批新弟子共计5322名，经掌门同意，三次东曦峰大比，第一次的前100名，第二次、第三次的前200名弟子，三次大比，共计500名弟子可直接进入内门，成为内门弟子。”
广场上众修士的眼神显得比刚才更加热切，刚才韩峰主说的虚无缥缈，而孟长老说的进入内门才是实实在在！
“第二件事，这十年内，你们每年有两次进入宗门试炼塔的机会，这两次机会很重要，各位要珍惜机会。如果能进入试炼塔年度排名前10，直接成为内门弟子。”
“当然，这个排名只是其次的，试炼塔奇妙无穷，诸位进去一试就知道了。”
“好了，我说完了。师兄、墨师妹，我就先回去了。”
孟长老干净利索的说完，然后朝韩峰主抱拳说道。
“一起走吧。志平，剩下的交给你们了。”
说完，三人御空而去，并没有借助飞剑。
“是，师尊！”何志平躬身说道。
等峰主和两位长老离开后，人群中逐渐窃窃私语起来。
“我一定要进入内门。”秦怀安旁边，林清萱攥着小拳头，满脸潮红，神情激动的说道。
呵，中二少女！秦怀安斜眼看了她一眼。
刚入门的弟子都是年轻人，甚至很多人都是二十岁以下的少年。人群中不乏像林清萱一样激动万分的，也有一些面容淡定。
五千多人最后选出五百人进入内门，不到十比一的比例。
等众人稍微安静一点后，何志平含笑向众人说道：
“各位师弟师妹，你们这批新入门弟子已全部到齐。从今天起，各位就算正式入宗了。”
“我身后这栋建筑是我们东曦峰的事务堂，事务堂负责东曦峰弟子的资源发放、丹药法宝购买兑换、任务领取等。”

“第一次领取修炼资源的时候，会同时发放一个初级储物袋，一把中品飞剑法器，一本炼气期基础功法，一本基础剑诀。”
“其他功法可到藏书阁借阅，借阅规则在藏书阁门口有说明，我就不多做介绍了。”
“另外，在广场西侧的传功崖，每天会有筑基以上修士在那里为你们传道解惑，有需要的可自行前往。”
“我们宗门并无太多约束，大家修行都是随心而动。”
“不过我个人建议，如果有能力，尽量去接一些宗门任务，赚取宗门贡献点。”
“好了，就说这么多吧，各位凭身份牌随时可以去领取配额的资源。预祝各位早日进入内门。”
“多谢何师兄”，人群发出一阵阵感谢声。
这个何师兄人还是挺不错的。秦怀安也随众人谢过之后，准备先去藏书阁看看。
五千多人解散，大部分都往事务殿走去，看来事务殿的弟子今天要加班了。
藏书阁在广场的东侧，秦怀安迈步向藏书阁走去。
“秦师兄，你不去领取配额资源吗？”林清萱拉了拉秦怀安的衣角问道。
秦怀安不动声色的躲开了一点。
content_en:
Elder Meng, a middle-aged man, said to everyone: "I don't have much to say, I will just say two things."
Loud voice.
He Zhiping turned his head slightly and looked at Master Han in embarrassment. Master Han was there, stroking his beard and smiling.
"The first thing is that there are 5,322 new disciples in your batch. With the approval of the master, after three Dongxi Peak competitions, the top 100 disciples in the first time, the top 200 disciples in the second and third competitions, and the three competitions, a total of 500 disciples can directly enter the inner sect and become inner sect disciples."
The eyes of the monks in the square seemed even more eager than before. What Peak Master Han said just now was illusory, but what Elder Meng said about entering the inner door is real!
"The second thing is that within these ten years, you will have two opportunities to enter the sect's trial tower every year. These two opportunities are very important. You must cherish the opportunity. If you can enter the top 10 in the trial tower's annual ranking, you will directly become an inner disciple."
"Of course, this ranking is only second. The trial tower is infinitely wonderful. You will know after you go in and try it."
"Okay, I'm done. Senior Brother, Junior Sister Mo, I will go back first."
Elder Meng finished speaking neatly, then cupped his fists towards Master Han and said.
"Let's go together. Zhiping, I'll leave the rest to you."
After saying that, the three of them flew away in the air without resorting to flying swords.
"Yes, Master!" He Zhiping bowed and said.
After the peak master and the two elders left, the crowd gradually began to whisper.
"I must enter the inner gate." Next to Qin Huaian, Lin Qingxuan clenched her fists, her face flushed, and she said excitedly.
Oh, middle school girl! Qin Huaian glanced at her sideways.
The disciples who have just started are all young people, and many of them are even teenagers under the age of twenty. There were some in the crowd who were as excited as Lin Qingxuan, and there were also some who had calm faces.
More than 5,000 people finally selected 500 people to enter the inner gate, with a ratio of less than ten to one.
After everyone became quieter, He Zhiping said to everyone with a smile:
"Junior brothers and sisters, all of you new disciples have arrived. From today on, you will officially join the sect."
"The building behind me is the affairs hall of our Dongxifeng. The affairs hall is responsible for the distribution of resources, the purchase and exchange of elixirs and magic weapons, and the collection of tasks for the disciples of Dongxifeng."
"When you receive training resources for the first time, you will be given a basic storage bag, a mid-grade flying sword weapon, a basic Qi-refining period technique, and a basic sword technique."
"Other exercises can be borrowed from the Library Pavilion. The borrowing rules are explained at the door of the Library Pavilion, so I won't introduce them in detail."
"In addition, at the Chuan Gong Cliff on the west side of the square, there will be monks above Foundation Establishment there to preach and answer your questions every day. If you need it, you can go there by yourself."
"Our sect doesn't have many restrictions. Everyone practices according to their heart."
"But I personally suggest that if you have the ability, try to take on some sect tasks and earn sect contribution points."
"Okay, that's all. You can collect the quota resources at any time with your ID card. I wish you all can enter the inner gate as soon as possible."
"Thank you, Senior Brother He", the crowd let out bursts of thanks.
Senior Brother He is quite a good person. Qin Huaian also thanked everyone and planned to go to the library to have a look first.
More than 5,000 people dispersed, and most of them went to the Affairs Hall. It seemed that the disciples in the Affairs Hall were going to work overtime today.
The Library Pavilion is on the east side of the square. Qin Huaian walked towards the Library Pavilion.
"Senior Brother Qin, aren't you going to collect the quota resources?" Lin Qingxuan asked Qin Huai'an, pulling on his clothes.
Qin Huaian ducked away quietly.
